records.source_Japanese: この街には航海士はいないのかな
records.current_English: No navigators in this town?

records.source_Japanese: どんな街にでも、船乗りはいるもんさ
records.current_English: Every town has sailors.

records.source_Japanese:
そうだな、街の人に聞いてみるか
ジェナス、ちょっと行って聞いてこいよ
records.current_English:
Let's ask around. Janus, go see
 what the locals know.

records.source_Japanese: 人使いが荒いですねぇ。…もう
records.current_English: Always ordering me around...

records.source_Japanese:
あのー。ちょっとすいません
船に詳しい人を捜してるんですけど…
records.current_English:
Excuse me. I'm looking for someone 
 who knows a lot about ships...

records.source_Japanese:
ほう。あんた船乗りさんかい
…だがアーデルンカッツの旦那はのう…
records.current_English:
Oh, you're sailors, are you? Well, 
 Mr. Adernkatz... Hmm...

records.source_Japanese:
…いやいや。何でもないよ
ひょっひょっひょっ
records.current_English: No, never mind. Heh heh heh.

records.source_Japanese:
何ですかねぇ。薄気味悪いおじさんです
アーデ…？　アーデルンカッツとか
言ってたっけ。…捜してみますかね
records.current_English:
What a creepy fellow. Adern... 
 Adernkatz, was it? Might as well 
 look for him.

records.source_Japanese:
提督。アーデルン何とかっていう人の
噂を聞きましたけど
records.current_English:
Admiral, I heard about someone 
 called Adern... something.

records.source_Japanese:
何っ！！　アーデルンカッツ！？
…間違いないな、ジェナス！
records.current_English:
What?! Adernkatz?! 
 You're sure, Janus?

records.source_Japanese: ウソなんか言いませんよ
records.current_English: I wouldn't make it up!

records.source_Japanese: …よし！
records.current_English: Good!

records.source_Japanese: クラウ！　待ってよ！
records.current_English: Clau! Wait!

records.source_Japanese:
おい、そこのぼうず！
『ゲルハルト・アーデルンカッツ』は
どこに住んでるんだ？
records.current_English:
Hey, kid!
 Where does Gerhard Adernkatz live?

records.source_Japanese:
アーデルンカッツ提督のこと？
提督のお屋敷ならあっちだよ
records.current_English:
You mean Admiral Adernkatz?
 His house is that way.

records.source_Japanese:
提督…。やっぱりな
ありがとよ、ぼうず。向こうだな
FI、早くしろ
records.current_English:
Admiral... I thought so. Thanks, 
 kid. That way, right?
 Hurry up, FI!

records.source_Japanese:
…珍しいね
クラウがこんなに乗り気なのって
records.current_English:
...You're usually
 not this eager, Clau.

records.source_Japanese:
そうじゃねえ…
まあいい。行きゃあ分かる
records.current_English:
That's not why... Never mind.
 You'll see when we get there.

records.source_Japanese: ここかな？
records.current_English: Here?

records.source_Japanese: …らしいな
records.current_English: ...Looks like it.

records.source_Japanese: （コンコン）
records.current_English: (Knock, knock.)

records.source_Japanese: …誰かな
records.current_English: ...Who is it?

records.source_Japanese:
あっ、初めまして
僕、FOの…
records.current_English:
Oh, hello. I'm 
 with FO, and...

records.source_Japanese:
FI・FA
提督だ
俺は航海士のクラウディオ・マナウス
records.current_English:
This is Admiral
 FI FA. 
 I'm Claudio Manaus, a navigator.

records.source_Japanese:
ほう、航海士…
何のご用があってのことかな
records.current_English: A navigator... What brings you here?

records.source_Japanese:
あなたが腕利きの航海士と聞いて
きましたので、お話を…
records.current_English:
We heard you're an excellent 
 navigator. We were hoping to speak 
 with you...

records.source_Japanese:
昔のことだ
今は見ての通り。オカ住まいだよ
records.current_English:
That was a long time ago. I live 
 ashore now, as you can see.

records.source_Japanese:
もう一度
船に乗っていただけませんか？
records.current_English:
Would you consider going 
 back to sea?

records.source_Japanese: 断る
records.current_English: No.

records.source_Japanese:
そうはいかねえんだよ
…ヴェルスは知っているな
records.current_English:
You can't brush us off that easily.
 You know Vels, don't you?

records.source_Japanese: あんたの逃がしたヤツだよ
records.current_English: The man you let escape.

records.source_Japanese: ！？　ど、どういうこと！？
records.current_English: What?! W-what are you talking about?

records.source_Japanese:
クラウ！
いったいどういうことなんです！？
records.current_English: Clau! What are you talking about?!

records.source_Japanese:
この人は
『ゲルハルト・アーデルンカッツ』提督
海賊退治専門の私設最強艦隊の
元海軍大提督だよ
records.current_English:
This is Admiral Gerhard Adernkatz. 
 He commanded the strongest 
 private fleet ever put together
 to hunt pirates.

records.source_Japanese:
北海から地中海にかけて一時
海賊たちが鳴りをひそめたときが
あったんだ。この人の艦隊が暴れ
回った成果さ
records.current_English:
For a while, pirates kept
 their heads down from the North Sea
 to the Mediterranean.
 That was Gerhard's fleet at work.

records.source_Japanese:
！！！
そんなにすごい人なの！？
records.current_English: He did all that?!

records.source_Japanese:
この人の海軍が、あるとき大きな海賊の
一団を捕らえたことがあった
その中にヴェルスがいたのさ
records.current_English:
His fleet once captured a big gang 
 of pirates. Vels was one of them.

records.source_Japanese: ええっ！　何ですって！？
records.current_English: What?!

records.source_Japanese:
…もういい。マナウス君とかいったな
あとは私が話そう
そちらの提督さんたちも入り給え
records.current_English:
That's enough. Mr. Manaus, is it?
 I'll tell the rest.
 Come in, Admiral.
 The rest of you, too.

records.source_Japanese:
ヴェルスは、まだ若かったうえに
見どころがあった
だから、私が引き取って鍛えたのだ
records.current_English:
Vels was still young, and I saw
 promise in him.
 So I took him in and trained him.

records.source_Japanese:
海賊ヴェルスが…
海軍大提督の弟子…！？
records.current_English:
Vels the pirate... 
 an admiral's pupil?!

records.source_Japanese:
ヤツは私が船を与えてやった途端
叛乱を起こし、逃亡したのだ
そのあと、私は自ら任を降りた
records.current_English:
The moment I gave him a ship,
 he mutinied and fled.
 After that, I resigned my command.

records.source_Japanese: どうしてそのとき追わなかったんだ？
records.current_English: Why didn't you go after him then?

records.source_Japanese:
長年、一緒に戦ってくれていた部下も
自由な身の上と金の誘惑につられ
ヤツについて行ってしまった
records.current_English:
Some of my crew had fought beside
 me for years. The promise
 of freedom and money drew them 
 after him.

records.source_Japanese:
…厳しい規律と倹約を美徳としてきた
私のやり方が間違っていたのかも
しれない
私は自分の指揮に自信を失ったのだ
records.current_English:
...I believed in strict discipline 
 and living frugally. Maybe 
 I was wrong. I lost faith
 in my own command.

records.source_Japanese: 私は一度海を捨てた男なのだよ！
records.current_English: I turned my back on the sea!

records.source_Japanese:
ここでの生活は恵まれている
周囲の人もそっとしておいてくれる
毎日が平穏無事に、ただただ過ぎて
行くのだ…
records.current_English:
I have a good life here. People
 leave me in peace. The days go 
 by, quiet and uneventful...

records.source_Japanese:
…本当にそれで解決
というわけではありませんよね？
records.current_English: But that hasn't settled it, has it?

records.source_Japanese:
FI君といったね
何を言いたいのかな
はっきりと口に出してみたまえ
records.current_English:
FI, was it? 
 What are you getting at? Go on.
 Say it plainly.

records.source_Japanese:
私たちの艦隊は
彼らに危うくやられるところでした
あなたの協力が必要なんです
records.current_English:
Vels nearly wiped out our fleet. 
 We need your help.

records.source_Japanese:
協力、か…
ロートルの意見など役には立つまい…
私はヤツにすべてを奪われたのだ
records.current_English:
My help? What good would an old
 man's advice do? He took 
 everything from me.

records.source_Japanese: いいえ、そんなことはありません
records.current_English: That's not true.

records.source_Japanese:
FI君…
君はこの私に何を期待しているのだ？
records.current_English:
FI...
 What do you expect from me?

records.source_Japanese: ヴェルスを倒しましょう
records.current_English: Let's defeat Vels.

records.source_Japanese: 倒さなくてもいいんです
records.current_English: Our fleet needs you.

records.source_Japanese:
あなたは身ひとつで
僕たちの船に乗ってくれるだけで
かまいません
一緒にヴェルスを倒しましょう！
records.current_English:
Just come aboard as you are. 
 That's all we ask. 
 Let's defeat Vels together!

records.source_Japanese:
気を悪くしないでくれたまえ
私が協力しても、君があのヴェルスと
渡り合えるとはとても思えないのだ
records.current_English:
Please don't take offense. Even
 with my help, I can't see
 you holding your own against Vels.

records.source_Japanese: 実力がともなっていないと…？
records.current_English: You don't think we're ready...?

records.source_Japanese: …考えさせてくれ
records.current_English: Let me think.

records.source_Japanese:
分かりました…。次にお会いする
ときには、決心してもらえると
信じてます。失礼しました
records.current_English:
Of course. I hope you'll 
 have decided by the time we meet 
 again. Excuse us.

records.source_Japanese: 生意気だと思ったなら許してください
records.current_English: Forgive me if I spoke out of turn.

records.source_Japanese:
でも僕は、最強と呼ばれた艦隊を
作り上げたあなたのやり方が
間違っていたとは
どうしても思えない
records.current_English:
But you built a fleet they called
 the strongest. I can't believe 
 you were wrong to lead it your way.

records.source_Japanese:
間違っているのはヴェルスのほうです
欲に目がくらんであなたを裏切った
男を僕は許すことができません！
records.current_English:
Vels was in the wrong. Greed 
 blinded him, and he betrayed you.
 I can't forgive that!

records.source_Japanese:
…しかし、ヴェルスは用心深い
そう簡単にはおびき出せまい
records.current_English:
But Vels is cautious. He won't 
 be easy to draw out.

records.source_Japanese:
今はヤツも図に乗っています
あなたが海に戻ったと噂を広めれば
きっと自分から姿を現しますよ
records.current_English:
He's gotten cocky. Spread the word 
 that you're back at sea, and he'll 
 come out on his own.

records.source_Japanese:
そうかもしれない
私がまだ生きているとは
思っていないだろうからな
records.current_English:
Perhaps. He probably doesn't think 
 I'm still alive.

records.source_Japanese: それじゃあ…！
records.current_English: Then...!

records.source_Japanese:
分かった。私のまいた種だ
私がケリをつけねばならん
records.current_English:
Very well. I set this in motion. 
 I ought to see it through.

records.source_Japanese:
ありがとうございます！
僕たちも、鍛えてください
覚悟はできています
records.current_English:
Thank you! Train us, too. We're
 ready for it.

records.source_Japanese: よかろう。私は厳しいぞ
records.current_English: Very well. I won't go easy on you.

records.source_Japanese:
あなたの協力がほしいのは…
ヴェルスを倒すためだけでは
ありません
records.current_English:
Defeating Vels isn't the only
 reason we want your help...

records.source_Japanese: …どういうことだ
records.current_English: What do you mean?

records.source_Japanese:
僕たちの艦隊のために船に乗って
ください！　あなたがいてくれれば
きっと歴史に残るような大きな仕事が
できると思うんです！
records.current_English:
Come aboard for our fleet's sake!
 With you along, we could do
 something worth remembering.

records.source_Japanese:
気を悪くしないでくれたまえ
君のような少年にそのような立派な
演説をされてもこの身を預ける決心が
つかないのだ
records.current_English:
Please don't take offense. Fine
 words from someone your age
 can't persuade me to put my life 
 in your hands.

records.source_Japanese: 実力がともなっていないと…？
records.current_English: You don't think we're ready...?

records.source_Japanese:
とにかく、私は海を捨てた身
今日のところは引き取ってもらおう
records.current_English:
I've left the sea behind.
 For today, I'd like you to go.

records.source_Japanese:
分かりました…。次にお会いする
ときには、決心してもらえると
信じてます。失礼しました
records.current_English:
Of course. I hope you'll 
 have decided by the time we meet 
 again. Excuse us.

records.source_Japanese: 生意気だと思ったなら許してください
records.current_English: Forgive me if I spoke out of turn.

records.source_Japanese:
でも僕は、最強と呼ばれた艦隊を
作り上げたあなたのやり方が
間違っていたとは
どうしても思えない
records.current_English:
But you built a fleet they called
 the strongest. I can't believe 
 you were wrong to lead it your way.

records.source_Japanese:
あなたの戦い方を僕たちに教えて
ください！
お願いします！
records.current_English: Teach us how you fight! Please!

records.source_Japanese: 私は厳しいぞ
records.current_English: I won't go easy on you.

records.source_Japanese: それじゃあ…！！
records.current_English: Then...!!

records.source_Japanese:
よかろう
ただ、覚悟をしてもらうぞ
records.current_English:
All right. But you'd better
 be ready.

records.source_Japanese:
それでは…。私が海に出る前に
教えておくことがある。どうだ？
特別訓練を受ける気があるかな？
records.current_English:
Before I go back to sea, there's 
 something I'd like to teach
 you. Are you up for some 
 special training?

records.source_Japanese: 厳しい訓練を受ける
records.current_English: Take the tough training.

records.source_Japanese: 話だけを聞く
records.current_English: Just listen to the lesson.

records.source_Japanese: 自分のやり方を貫く
records.current_English: Stick with my own style.

records.source_Japanese: いい度胸だ。途中でネをあげるな
records.current_English:
You've got nerve. Don't give up
 halfway through.

records.source_Japanese:
少しはサマになってきたようだな
では船に案内してもらおうか
records.current_English:
Now you're looking the part. Show
 me to your ship.

records.source_Japanese:
そうだな…。道すがら
戦闘について説明しておこうか
records.current_English:
I'll explain naval combat
 on the way.

records.source_Japanese: はい、お願いします
records.current_English: Yes, please.

records.source_Japanese:
まずは、艦砲射撃。いわゆる砲撃戦に
ついてだ。ここでは、定石の
Ｔ字戦法について説明しよう
records.current_English:
Let's start with naval gunfire.
 I'll show you a classic tactic 
 called crossing the T.

records.source_Japanese:
敵の射程範囲である側面はなるべく
避け、敵船の正面あるいは背後に
回り込んで自分の船の側面を敵船に
向けて射撃するのがいい
records.current_English:
Stay clear of their broadside. 
 Pass ahead of the bow or behind
 the stern, then turn your broadside
 toward them and fire.

records.source_Japanese: はい…
records.current_English: Yes...

records.source_Japanese:
船を動かしてさえやれば、砲手が撃って
くれる。このとき、『武装砲台』に
命中能力の高い航海士をおくと
砲撃効果が高い
records.current_English:
Steer and let your gunners fire. 
 To improve their fire, assign
 an officer with high Aim 
 to a Gun Battery.

records.source_Japanese:
海戦時も、通常の航海の移動と
同じように、船の進路と帆の向きを
操作します。敵船が射程に入ったら
自動的に射撃が行われます
records.current_English:
Steer and adjust the sails as usual
 during naval battles.

current_FE_continuation.english:
Your ship fires automatically when 
 an enemy ship comes within range.

records.source_Japanese:
白兵戦を主体にしたければ
街の造船所で、船倉の改造を行って
『海兵詰所』を作っておくと
いいだろう
records.current_English:
If you prefer boarding, go 
 to the shipyard and refit a hold 
 into Quarters.

records.source_Japanese:
あとは、白兵戦に備えて、水夫を多めに
雇い剣闘術の優秀な者を斬り込み隊長と
して海兵詰所におくと、さらに
効果的だろう
records.current_English:
Hire plenty of sailors. Then assign
 an officer with high Swords to the 
 Quarters as Boarding Leader. That
 will make boarding more effective.

records.source_Japanese:
剣闘術の優秀な航海士を選択して
海兵詰所に送り込んでみましょう
records.current_English:
Select an officer with high Swords 
 and assign them to the Quarters.

records.source_Japanese:
船同士が接触すると、自動的に白兵戦と
なります。斬り込み隊長が活躍して
くれるはずです
records.current_English:
Boarding starts automatically when 
 ships touch. Your Boarding Leader
 should make a difference.

records.source_Japanese: …というわけだ
records.current_English: That is all.

records.source_Japanese:
…分かりました
あとは実戦で経験を積むことですね
ありがとうございました…
records.current_English:
Understood. Now we need experience 
 in a real battle. Thank you.

records.source_Japanese:
FIの
体力、敏捷、精神が上がりました！
records.current_English:
FI's Stamina, Agility, 
 and Spirit increased!

records.source_Japanese: まあいいだろう
records.current_English: Very well.

records.source_Japanese:
そうだな…
では、戦闘についての話をしておこう
records.current_English: Then I'll explain naval combat.

records.current_English: Yes, please.

Ｔ字戦法について説明しよう
records.current_English:
Let's start with naval gunfire.

records.current_English:

records.current_English:
Steer and let your gunners fire.

records.current_English:

いいだろう
records.current_English:
If you prefer boarding, go

雇い剣闘術の優秀な者を斬り込み隊長と

records.current_English:

records.current_English:
Select an officer with high Swords

なります。斬り込み隊長が活躍して

records.current_English:
Boarding starts automatically when 
 ships touch. Your Boarding Leader
 should make a difference.

records.source_Japanese: …というわけだ。分かったかな
records.current_English: That's all. Is that clear?

records.source_Japanese:
…はい。あとは実戦の経験を積むこと
ですね。ありがとうございました…
records.current_English:
Yes. Now we need experience
 in a real battle. Thank you.

records.source_Japanese:
FIの
知力が上がりました！
records.current_English: FI's Wits increased!

records.source_Japanese:
…なるほどな
教わるべきことは船の上というわけか
それもよかろう
records.current_English:
...I see. You'd rather learn aboard
 ship. Very well.

records.source_Japanese:
FIの
運勢が上がりました！
records.current_English: FI's Luck increased!
